name: SideNav
title: Components/Navigation/SideNav
description: Organize a workspace into stable destinations and nested groups.
purpose: Organize a workspace into stable destinations and nested groups.
usage: Control activeId with onNavigate. Choose a transparent rail or a subtly filled floating panel with rounded corners. Both can collapse without losing item labels or keyboard access.

props.name: brandIcon
props.description: Pass null to show only the brand name.

props.name: showWorkspace
props.description: Show the expanded workspace summary below the brand.

props.name: workspaceContent
props.description: Replace the expanded workspace summary; hidden and inert in the collapsed rail.
